author: Brandjuh
name: CuffRecords
short: Rap sheets: every enforcement action on file with a case number.
description: The precinct archive — every enforcement action lands on a member's rap sheet with its own case number. [p]rapsheet reads a member's sheet (relative Discord timestamps, newest first, counts per type), [p]filerecord files one by hand, [p]expunge erases one case or a whole sheet, and [p]archive summarises what is on file. Other cogs file through the add_record seam: CuffAffairs calls it whenever a citation is issued. Ported from the CuffBot Node module src/modules/records.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per member with a record: the record type, the reason text an officer wrote, the officer's user id and the time it was filed. Moderators can erase a sheet with [p]expunge, and Red's data deletion request removes it everywhere.
